أقتني (form VIII)
# أَقْتَنِي (ʔaqtanī) /ʔaq.ta.niː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# أَقْتَنِيَ (ʔaqtaniya) /ʔaq.ta.ni.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
